text: How do I clean and maintain a Barista Express or Barista Pro: cleaning cycle, descaling, burrs, gaskets, and what is actually needed?

attempts.why: Became barista-express-pro-clean-descale-routine. Signals are OzBargain threads about the clean/descale light and owners giving up after skipping cleaning. US and UK autocomplete ('cleaning cycle', 'descale', 'cleaning cycle not working') points the same way but isn't counted as a signal.
